findings.passage: “This simply says we’re going to treat you all like the adults you are,” Rep. Shae Sortwell, R-Two Rivers, said. “We’re going to trust you to be responsible.”
findings.note: Quoted by Wisconsin Public Radio on the Assembly floor about his bill lowering the concealed carry permit age from 21 to 18.
subjects: lower the age to carry a concealed gun
carry a gun with a permit

findings.passage: “I think it's a basic premise of equality under the law. While some people talk about this being a Second Amendment issue — and to an extent it is — it’s actually more of a 14th Amendment issue where all adults should be treated equally under the law,” Sortwell said.
findings.note: Interview quoted by Fox 11 on why he wants the concealed carry permit age lowered to 18.
subjects: lower the age to carry a concealed gun
Second Amendment and equal treatment of adults

findings.passage: “You’re not talking about 18- and 19-year-olds being able to carry guns around school property. The current law on restrictions to that don’t change,” Sortwell said.
findings.note: Quoted by Fox 11 on his bill's effect on carrying near schools: the school-grounds restrictions stay the same for permit holders.
subjects: carry a gun with a permit

findings.passage: “The Department of Justice here in Wisconsin is the one that — under current law — approves the process from other states and they're supposed to basically be checking to make sure they're meeting our standards,” said Sortwell. “There are some states that don't have some of those restrictions in place but that's not going to change the fact that you can already possess a gun right now under current law without necessarily going through a background check.”
findings.note: Quoted by Fox 11 on the bill to honor other states' carry permits; he says a gun can already be possessed without a background check.

findings.passage: “Once again, this is not about the Second Amendment. It’s pretty clear. We even had an appellate court case recently that said this is a violation of the federal constitution to have these kinds of arbitrary restrictions in place for adults,” he said. “This is a constitutional issue under the 14th Amendment saying that every adult has the inherent right of self-defense.”
findings.note: Quoted by Fox 11 saying age limits on carry for adults are arbitrary and a constitutional issue.
subjects: lower the age to carry a concealed gun

findings.passage: Sortwell said the bill aims to give people a place to temporarily store firearms “so that while somebody is getting the help they need, while they’re working through their personal problems, they don’t have this temptation in the house,” he said.
findings.note: WPR report on his suicide-prevention bill with gun retailers storing firearms voluntarily surrendered; WPR also says he framed it as respecting constitutional rights.
subjects: voluntary temporary gun storage during a crisis
